import pytest

from lru import LRUCache


def test_get_missing_returns_minus_one():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    assert cache.get("missing") == -1


def test_put_then_get():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, "a")
    assert cache.get(1) == "a"


def test_evicts_least_recently_used_on_insert():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, "a")
    cache.put(2, "b")
    cache.put(3, "c")  # evicts 1
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert cache.get(2) == "b"
    assert cache.get(3) == "c"


def test_get_refreshes_recency():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, "a")
    cache.put(2, "b")
    assert cache.get(1) == "a"  # 1 is now most recent; 2 is LRU
    cache.put(3, "c")  # evicts 2
    assert cache.get(2) == -1
    assert cache.get(1) == "a"
    assert cache.get(3) == "c"


def test_update_existing_key_counts_as_use():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, "a")
    cache.put(2, "b")
    cache.put(1, "a2")  # update refreshes 1; 2 is LRU
    cache.put(3, "c")  # evicts 2
    assert cache.get(2) == -1
    assert cache.get(1) == "a2"
    assert cache.get(3) == "c"


def test_update_does_not_change_size():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, "a")
    cache.put(1, "b")
    cache.put(2, "c")
    assert cache.get(1) == "b"
    assert cache.get(2) == "c"
    assert len(cache) == 2


def test_capacity_boundary_exactly_full_no_eviction():
    cache = LRUCache(3)
    cache.put(1, "a")
    cache.put(2, "b")
    cache.put(3, "c")
    assert len(cache) == 3
    assert cache.get(1) == "a"
    assert cache.get(2) == "b"
    assert cache.get(3) == "c"


def test_capacity_boundary_one_over_evicts_exactly_one():
    cache = LRUCache(3)
    for k in (1, 2, 3):
        cache.put(k, k)
    cache.put(4, 4)
    assert len(cache) == 3
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert [cache.get(k) for k in (2, 3, 4)] == [2, 3, 4]


def test_capacity_one():
    cache = LRUCache(1)
    cache.put(1, "a")
    assert cache.get(1) == "a"
    cache.put(2, "b")
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert cache.get(2) == "b"


def test_eviction_order_follows_full_access_sequence():
    cache = LRUCache(3)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    cache.put(3, 3)
    cache.get(1)      # order (LRU->MRU): 2, 3, 1
    cache.put(2, 22)  # order: 3, 1, 2
    cache.put(4, 4)   # evicts 3 -> 1, 2, 4
    assert cache.get(3) == -1
    cache.put(5, 5)   # evicts 1 -> 2, 4, 5
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert cache.get(2) == 22
    assert cache.get(4) == 4
    assert cache.get(5) == 5


def test_missing_get_does_not_affect_recency():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, "a")
    cache.put(2, "b")
    cache.get(99)  # miss; must not disturb order
    cache.put(3, "c")  # evicts 1
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert cache.get(2) == "b"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", [0, -1, 2.5, "3", None, True])
def test_invalid_capacity_rejected(bad):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        LRUCache(bad)

    cache.put(3, "c")  # evicts 2
    assert cache.get(2) == -1
    assert cache.get(1) == "a"
    assert cache.get(3) == "c"


def test_failed_get_does_not_affect_order():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, "a")
    cache.put(2, "b")
    assert cache.get(99) == -1
    cache.put(3, "c")  # 1 is still LRU
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert cache.get(2) == "b"


def test_update_counts_as_use():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, "a")
    cache.put(2, "b")
    cache.put(1, "a2")  # 1 is now most recent; 2 is LRU
    cache.put(3, "c")  # evicts 2
    assert cache.get(2) == -1
    assert cache.get(1) == "a2"
    assert cache.get(3) == "c"


def test_update_does_not_evict():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, "a")
    cache.put(2, "b")
    cache.put(2, "b2")  # update at full capacity must not evict anything
    assert cache.get(1) == "a"
    assert cache.get(2) == "b2"
    assert len(cache) == 2


def test_eviction_order_across_many_operations():
    cache = LRUCache(3)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    cache.put(3, 3)
    cache.get(1)  # order (LRU -> MRU): 2, 3, 1
    cache.put(4, 4)  # evicts 2 -> 3, 1, 4
    assert cache.get(2) == -1
    cache.get(3)  # -> 1, 4, 3
    cache.put(5, 5)  # evicts 1 -> 4, 3, 5
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert cache.get(4) == 4
    assert cache.get(3) == 3
    assert cache.get(5) == 5

    cache = LRUCache(3)
    cache.put(1, "a")
    cache.put(2, "b")
    cache.put(3, "c")
    assert len(cache) == 3
    assert cache.get(1) == "a"
    assert cache.get(2) == "b"
    assert cache.get(3) == "c"


def test_one_past_capacity_evicts_exactly_one():
    cache = LRUCache(3)
    for k in range(1, 5):
        cache.put(k, k)
    assert len(cache) == 3
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert all(cache.get(k) == k for k in (2, 3, 4))


def test_capacity_one():
    cache = LRUCache(1)
    cache.put(1, "a")

def test_size_never_exceeds_capacity():
    cache = LRUCache(4)

        assert len(cache) <= 4

    assert [cache.get(k) for k in range(96, 100)] == [96, 97, 98, 99]

def test_leetcode_canonical_sequence():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    assert cache.get(1) == 1
    cache.put(3, 3)
    assert cache.get(2) == -1

    cache = LRUCache(2)

    cache.put(1, "a")

def test_update_existing_key_counts_as_use():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, "a")

    assert cache.get(3) == "c"


def test_update_does_not_change_size():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, "a")
    cache.put(1, "b")
    cache.put(2, "c")

    assert cache.get(1) == "b"

    cache.put(1, "a")
    cache.put(2, "b")
    assert cache.get(99) == -1
    cache.put(3, "c")  # still evicts 1
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert cache.get(2) == "b"


def test_fill_to_exact_capacity_keeps_everything():
    cache = LRUCache(3)
    for k in (1, 2, 3):
        cache.put(k, k * 10)
    assert len(cache) == 3
    for k in (1, 2, 3):
        assert cache.get(k) == k * 10


def test_one_past_capacity_evicts_exactly_one():
    cache = LRUCache(3)
    for k in (1, 2, 3, 4):
        cache.put(k, k)
    assert len(cache) == 3

    cache.put(1, "a")

    cache.put(4, 4)  # evicts 3
    assert cache.get(3) == -1
    cache.put(5, 5)  # evicts 1

    assert cache.get(4) == 4
